wrapping: RepeatWrapping U/V, set by owned clone
notes: Recommendations require final scene-owner review; do not duplicate wood bytes for woodDark.
Input textures belong to caller; environment owns and disposes its clones only.
Box/RoundedBox UV are per face 0..1; Extrude uses model-local XY/edge UV. verticalWood rotates UV (u,v) to (1-v,u). Choose repeat using actual UV, not image pixel size.
Current frozen 316 compositor still uses legacy wood repeat (2,4) and does not load new slots.
Leather is lazy in API snapshot and needs the next environment geometry pass; do not assign wood to suitcase bodies.
No normal/bump/roughness maps, baked light, edges, frames, fasteners or labels.
